description: This file implements authentication utilities for a Flask application, including functions to create, decode, and validate JWT tokens and extract user information from request headers.

methods.name: str create_access_token(identity: Dict[str, Any], expires_in_minutes: int = 60)
methods.description: Creates a JWT access token with user identity and optional expiration in minutes.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] decode_token(token: str)
methods.description: Decodes and validates a JWT token, raising Unauthorized on failure.

methods.name: int get_current_user_id_from_request()
methods.description: Extracts the Bearer token from the request headers and returns the user ID.

ctags.name: create_access_token
ctags.pattern: /^def create_access_token(identity: Dict[str, Any], expires_in_minutes: int = 60) -> str:$/
